_comment: Prose for the generated Vk::Result mirror (configure/generate_vk_result.py): VK_* name -> sentence. The generator appends ' (VK_NAME)' itself, so entries here carry the bare sentence only. A VkResult with no entry still generates -- with a configure-time warning and fallback prose -- so a header update never breaks the build for want of a sentence.
VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY: The driver ran out of host memory
VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY: The driver ran out of device memory
VK_ERROR_LAYER_NOT_PRESENT: A requested layer is not present
VK_ERROR_EXTENSION_NOT_PRESENT: A requested extension is not present
VK_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT: A requested feature is not present
VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED: The requested format is not supported
VK_ERROR_FRAGMENTED_POOL: The descriptor pool is too fragmented
VK_ERROR_UNKNOWN: The driver reported an unknown error
VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY: The pool ran out of memory
VK_ERROR_INVALID_OPAQUE_CAPTURE_ADDRESS: An opaque capture address is invalid
VK_ERROR_FRAGMENTATION: The operation failed due to fragmentation
VK_ERROR_NATIVE_WINDOW_IN_USE_KHR: The native window is already in use
VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR: The swapchain no longer matches the surface
VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR: The swapchain is out of date
VK_ERROR_IMAGE_USAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED_KHR: The image usage is not supported
VK_ERROR_VIDEO_PICTURE_LAYOUT_NOT_SUPPOR: The video picture layout is not supported
VK_ERROR_VIDEO_PROFILE_OPERATION_NOT_SUP: The video profile operation is not supported
VK_ERROR_VIDEO_PROFILE_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPOR: The video profile format is not supported
VK_ERROR_VIDEO_PROFILE_CODEC_NOT_SUPPORT: The video profile codec is not supported
VK_ERROR_VIDEO_STD_VERSION_NOT_SUPPORTED: The video Std version is not supported
VK_ERROR_INVALID_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_PLA: The DRM format-modifier plane layout is invalid
VK_ERROR_PRESENT_TIMING_QUEUE_FULL_EXT: The present-timing feedback queue is full
VK_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_SPACE_KHR: The driver ran out of space
